top_signals.title: Exxon Reaps Record Oil-Refining Profits on War-Driven Gasoline, Diesel Spikes
top_signals.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. surpassed profit expectations on the strength of surging gasoline and diesel prices that pushed refining results to an all-time high as conflicts in the Persian Gulf and Russia upended energy markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
